trigger: Full-scale fusion passed its training/dev gate and required independent confirmation before ratification.
lesson: Freeze challenge specification, thresholds, data hash, and repository revision before observing any challenge result. Evaluate all candidate checkpoints once. Do not alter thresholds after results.
general_rule: Post-training ratification challenges should be immutable before observation and should preserve a cryptographic freeze receipt tying data/spec/revision together.

trigger: Need to validate generalization without turning evaluation failures into a train-on-test loop.
lesson: Frozen challenge rows must be evaluation-only for that ratification decision. Failure may guide diagnosis and independent successor data generation, but the frozen rows themselves are not folded into training and re-used for grading.
general_rule: Keep ratification challenge immutable and training-forbidden; use failures as category-level evidence, not reusable labels for the same gate.

trigger: Step160 and step240 both passed in-distribution fusion gate while step240 was provisionally strongest.
lesson: Do not ratify provisional training winner until untouched challenge. Evaluate the full saved candidate set under one frozen metric policy and select only among checkpoints that pass every hard gate.
general_rule: Training/dev selection nominates candidates; untouched evaluation determines ratification eligibility.
